title: [LUNA ENGINE SCRIPT REQUEST] Script for show subskill icons on skill select window?

posts.author: KeatonGamer1248
posts.body:
Hi all, Keaton here.
I've been working on my OMORI GR2 DEMO RECREATION for quite some time now, and I've never actually figured out how to replicate the selectable subskill icons when selecting a skill during a battle, like how they pulled it off in the original demo from 2014.
I've attached an example of how I want it to look like, minus the MP numbers, of course:
The clover icon is sub-skill variant number 1, and the diamond-shaped icon is sub-skill variant number 2. The icons will be from the Iconset, and each subskill will have a different description, here's an example:
Spoiler:
Example of the subskill descriptions
Code:
VARIANT NO. 1:

SCANS A TARGET
COSTS 5 EN.

VARIANT NO. 2:

SCANS TWO TARGETS
COSTS 10 EN.
I have also searched for a script that does this, including Luna Engine's folders, but I just couldn't find any...

I already know that Archeia worked on both the original demo and Luna Engine. I also already know that the team switched the game's engine from VX Ace to MV.
However, it should be noted that the original demo from 2014 was never released online - therefore it is currently lost media, and lost media can be really hard to find unless you know someone who actually has it or where to look. That is also why I'm recreating it. It is mostly finished, but I need to add the stuff that goes with it (e.g. Voiceclips, The Checklist from the Treasure Chest, collectable cakes after defeating a boss, etc.) Fortunately, we have the right scripts to recreate the demo from 2014.
